The '''White Belt''' is a {{Common}} [[Belts|Belt]]. It is obtainable from {{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} as the first {{Zone|Dojo}} reward. It gives {{Stat|hp|+10}} and {{Stat|def|+5}}. Its ability reduces all damage taken by {{Green|0.5%}}. This item is automatically {{DG|Soulbound}} upon receiving it.

== Upgrading ==
The '''White Belt''' can be upgraded into the {{Item|Yellow Belt}} after reaching 1000 points in the {{Zone|Dojo}}.

== Trivia ==
*This is the only belt from the {{Zone|Dojo}} that is received without needing to reach a specific score.
*Together with its successors, it has an uncommon limit to how many [[Star Upgrades]] can be applied to it.
**Furthermore this item has this limit at its lowest of all starrable items in the game.
*The price of this item at {{NPCSprite|Rusty}} is not affected by the {{Item|Shady Ring}} and its upgraded versions.
